scope: Clone the two-handed Fury preset; keep Bonereaver's Edge, level 60 Night Elf, all gear, enchants, buffs, fight settings and available cooldown/consumable schedules. Require 51 points, at least 31 Arms and Mortal Strike. Main search uses Arms/Fury; separately audit seven-point Protection allocations with Improved Bloodrage.
objective: Mean of individual fights' DPS. UI damage / duration is also reported.

search.talents: Multistart eight-member beam search across legal Arms allocations, followed by one-point transfers alternating with ability searches. Canonical filler choices omit irrelevant utility and offhand-only talents. Separately compare 68 allocations with 7 Protection points, and 224 combined Spearing Strike talent/rotation changes.
search.abilities: Three conditional passes through all 1,957 ordered subsets of Mortal Strike, Whirlwind, Slam, Overpower, Hamstring and Rend in normal phase. Each execute pass tests 4,240 distinct orders after omitting unreachable fallbacks costing at least as much rage as Execute. Rage thresholds, main-ability cooldown restrictions, after-swing Slam, Heroic Strike/Berserker Rage toggles, and Rend settings; finer thresholds and order changes in final refinement.
search.validation: Selection frozen before three nonoverlapping seed blocks; 1,500,000 fights per comparison.
search.limitations: Conditional and local search, not an exhaustive global optimum. Available cooldown/consumable schedules were fixed. Bloodthirst and Death Wish are unavailable within the Arms constraint. Small differences between close configurations can be sampling noise.
